claims.claim: The experiment was implemented in MATLAB using Psychtoolbox extensions.
claims.evidence: It was implemented in MATLAB (Version R2016b; RRID: SCR_001622 ; The MathWorks, Inc, Natick, MA) using the Psychtoolbox extensions (RRID: SCR_002881 ).

claims.claim: Participants were recruited from the local population through advertisements and flyers.
claims.evidence: Participants were recruited from the local population through advertisements on online blackboards at the University of Bonn and on local community websites, and through flyers posted in libraries, university cafeterias and sports facilities.

claims.claim: The fMRI data from four participants were excluded due to excessive head motion.
claims.evidence: The fMRI data from four participants in Study 2 were excluded from the fMRI data analysis because of excessive head motion (>3 mm or >3°).

claims.claim: Bayes factors were calculated using default priors in JASP.
claims.evidence: Bayes factors were calculated using default priors in JASP and express the probability of the data given H1 relative to H0 (BF10, values larger than one are in favour of H1).

claims.claim: The fMRI data were analysed using SPM12 software.
claims.evidence: fMRI data were analysed using SPM12 software (RRID: SCR_007037 ; Wellcome Trust Centre for Neuroimaging, London, UK).

claims.claim: Functional connectivity analyses were performed using the gPPI toolbox for SPM.
claims.evidence: We used the gPPI toolbox ( McLaren et al., 2012 ) for SPM to run seed-to-voxel functional connectivity analyses.

claims.claim: All clusters reported survive a significance threshold of p < 0.05 with family-wise error correction.
claims.evidence: All clusters reported survive a significance threshold of p < 0.05 with family-wise error correction for multiple comparisons across the whole brain or a smaller volume when explicitly mentioned, based on an uncorrected voxel-wise (cluster-forming) threshold of p < 0.001.
